subject: Língua Inglesa
description_pt: Solicitar esclarecimentos em língua inglesa sobre o que não entendeu e o significado de palavras ou expressões desconhecidas.

components.description_pt: Pedir esclarecimento em inglês quando uma mensagem não é compreendida
components.description_en: Ask for clarification in English when a message is not understood
components.cc_component_description: Request clarification when something heard or presented orally is not understood

components.description_pt: Solicitar o significado de palavra ou expressão desconhecida em inglês
components.description_en: Request the meaning of an unfamiliar word or expression in English
components.cc_component_description: Ask questions about the meaning of an unfamiliar word in a text

components.description_pt: Usar frases apropriadas em inglês para sinalizar falha de comunicação
components.description_en: Use appropriate English phrases to signal a communication breakdown

components.description_pt: Aplicar expressões formulaicas polidas para pedir que o interlocutor repita ou reformule
components.description_en: Apply polite formulaic expressions to ask a speaker to repeat or rephrase
components.cc_component_description: Ask questions to clarify a peer's or adult's contribution during group discussion

cc_matches.description: Confirm understanding of a text read aloud or information presented orally or through other media by asking and answering questions about key details and requesting clarification if something is not understood.
With prompting and support, ask and answer questions about unknown words in a text.
Participate in collaborative conversations with diverse partners about kindergarten topics and texts with peers and adults in small and larger groups.
